The '''Blessed giant rat''' is a type of [[giant rat]] on the second level of the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]].

Due to its 600 [[life points]] and low [[Defence]], the blessed giant rat can be good for training combat on. However, it has no drops other than [[bones]] and its location is not ideal.
